```{r setup}
# | label: setup

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(rstan)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(sf)
library(scales)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggspatial)
library(ggh4x)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(biscale)


source(here("Scripts", "data_prep_functions.R"))
source(here("Scripts", "plot_functions.R"))

dataset <- "Full"

case_data <- load_case_data()
case_age_data <- load_case_age_data()
population_data <- load_population_data()
sero_data <- load_sero_data()
map_data <- st_read(here("Analysis_data", "thailand_map.shp"))
```

```{r data-config}
# | label: data-config

# Define areas
if(dataset == "Full") {
    area  <- case_data %>% distinct(Area) %>% pull(Area)
} else {
    area  <- c("Chiang Rai", "Lampang",  "Nakhon Ratchasima", "Surin", "Songkhla", "Phatthalung", "Uttaradit", "Tak")
}
# 
# Time period
start_year <- 2003
end_year   <- 2024
n_periods  <- 4

# Seasonality
n_harmonics <- 3

# Serology survey years (Gonwong et al. 2022)
sero_years <- c(2007, 2008, 2012)

# Fixed epidemiological parameters
omega <- 1/(22.3/12)      # per year, average duration of immunity (22.3 months)
nu <- 0.15                # clinical sign probability
sigma_lambda_0 <- 0.1     # baseline FOI variation
sigma_lambda_y <- 0.122   # year-to-year FOI variation
sigma_lambda_init <- 0.75 # initial FOI variation

# Reference age group for susceptibility normalization
ref_age_label <- "25 to 35"

age_levels <- c("0 to 5", "5 to 15", "15 to 25", "25 to 35",
                "35 to 45", "45 to 55", "55 to 65", "above 65")

  # Population age group mapping (raw -> standardized)
pop_age_levels = c("0 to 4", "5 to 14", "15 to 24", "25 to 34",
                    "35 to 44", "45 to 54", "55 to 64", "above 65")

# Serology age group 
sero_age <- 3

config <- list(
  areas = area,
  start_year = start_year,
  end_year = end_year,
  n_periods = n_periods,
  n_harmonics = n_harmonics,
  sero_years = sero_years,
  omega = omega,
  nu = nu,
  sigma_lambda_0 = sigma_lambda_0,
  sigma_lambda_y = sigma_lambda_y,
  sigma_lambda_init = sigma_lambda_init,
  ref_age_label = ref_age_label,
  age_levels = age_levels,
  pop_age_levels = pop_age_levels
)
```

```{r data-preparation}
data <- prepare_stan_data(config)

stan_data <- data$stan_data
stan_data$sero_age <- sero_age  # Add serology age group to stan_data
calendar <- data$calendar
site_levels <- data$site_levels
region_levels <- data$region_levels
age_levels <- data$age_levels

# Save prepared data
save(
  stan_data, calendar, site_levels, region_levels, age_levels,
  file = here("Rout", paste("stan_data_", dataset, ".RData", sep = ""))
)

cat("Dimensions:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Provinces (S): %d\n", stan_data$S))
cat(sprintf("  Regions (R): %d\n", stan_data$R))
cat(sprintf("  Years (Y): %d\n", stan_data$Y))
cat(sprintf("  Months (T): %d\n", stan_data$T))
cat(sprintf("  Age groups (A): %d\n", stan_data$A))
cat(sprintf("  Periods (P): %d\n", stan_data$P))
cat(sprintf("  Harmonics (H): %d\n", stan_data$H))
```

```{r model-settings}
seed <- 12

model_settings <- data.frame(
  iter = getOption("stan.iter", 2000),
  warmup = getOption("stan.warmup", 1000),
  chains = getOption("stan.chains", 4),
  thin = getOption("stan.thin", 4),
  seed = getOption("stan.seed", seed)
)

model_file <- "Model10.stan"

save(model_settings, model_file, file = here("Rout", paste("model_settings_", dataset, ".RData", sep = "")))
```

Model Fitting

```{r model-fitting}
RUN_MODEL <- F
if(RUN_MODEL){
    system(paste('Rscript --vanilla Scripts/run_models_local.R', dataset, seed))
}
```

## Sensitivity analysis: nu and omega

Refit Model 10 with `nu` and `omega` each doubled and halved relative to their
baseline values (one parameter varied at a time, baseline held fixed for the
other). Everything else (data, `model_settings`, seed, `model_file`) matches
the baseline `Full` run so the four fits are comparable.

```{r sensitivity-config}
#| label: sensitivity-config

# One parameter varied at a time; baseline value used for the other
sensitivity_scenarios <- list(
  nu_x2      = list(nu = nu * 2),
  nu_x0.5    = list(nu = nu * 0.5),
  omega_x2   = list(omega = omega * 2),
  omega_x0.5 = list(omega = omega * 0.5)
)
```

```{r sensitivity-data-prep}
#| label: sensitivity-data-prep

# Prepares and saves stan_data_<scenario>.RData / model_settings_<scenario>.RData
# for one sensitivity scenario, reusing the baseline `config`, sampler
# settings, and model file. Local to this function -- does not touch the
# baseline stan_data/calendar/... objects in the global environment.
prepare_sensitivity_dataset <- function(scenario_name, param_overrides) {
  scenario_config <- modifyList(config, param_overrides)
  prepared <- prepare_stan_data(scenario_config)

  stan_data <- prepared$stan_data
  stan_data$sero_age <- sero_age
  calendar <- prepared$calendar
  site_levels <- prepared$site_levels
  region_levels <- prepared$region_levels
  age_levels <- prepared$age_levels

  save(stan_data, calendar, site_levels, region_levels, age_levels,
       file = here("Rout", paste0("stan_data_", scenario_name, ".RData")))

  # Reuse baseline sampler settings and Stan model file
  save(model_settings, model_file,
       file = here("Rout", paste0("model_settings_", scenario_name, ".RData")))

  message(sprintf("Prepared '%s': nu=%.4f, omega=%.4f",
                   scenario_name, scenario_config$nu, scenario_config$omega))
}

PREP_SENSITIVITY <- T
if (PREP_SENSITIVITY) {
  walk2(names(sensitivity_scenarios), sensitivity_scenarios, prepare_sensitivity_dataset)
}
```

```{r sensitivity-fitting}
#| label: sensitivity-fitting

# Fit one scenario at a time (blocking system() calls), reusing
# run_models_local.R exactly as the baseline model does.
RUN_SENSITIVITY <- F
if (RUN_SENSITIVITY) {
  for (scenario_name in names(sensitivity_scenarios)) {
    message(sprintf("[%s] Fitting scenario: %s", Sys.time(), scenario_name))
    system(paste('Rscript --vanilla Scripts/run_models_local.R', scenario_name, seed))
  }
}
```

Each fit is saved to `Rout/fit_<scenario_name>.RData` (e.g. `fit_nu_x2.RData`),
so they can be loaded and compared with `dataset <- "nu_x2"` etc. using the
same `load-fit`/diagnostic code as the baseline model.

### Population-standardised reported incidence and mortality

Average annual reported incidence per 100,000 and mortality per 1,000,000
population (Fig 1A-B), by province and health region, with directly
age-standardised rates (2004-2024, pooled national population as standard)
as a check that rankings are not driven by differences in age structure.

```{r reported-rates-province}
#| label: reported-rates-province
province_rates <- summarise_reported_rates(case_data, population_data) %>%
  left_join(summarise_age_standardised_rates(case_age_data, population_data), by = "Area")

province_rates %>%
  arrange(desc(incidence_100k)) %>%
  select(Area, Zone, cases, incidence_100k, asr_incidence_100k) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  kable(digits = 1, caption = "Provinces with the highest average annual reported incidence per 100,000")

province_rates %>%
  arrange(desc(mortality_1m)) %>%
  select(Area, Zone, deaths, mortality_1m, asr_mortality_1m) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "Provinces with the highest average annual reported mortality per 1,000,000")

province_rates %>%
  summarise(
    spearman_incidence = cor(incidence_100k, asr_incidence_100k, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    spearman_mortality = cor(mortality_1m, asr_mortality_1m, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  )
```

```{r reported-rates-region}
#| label: reported-rates-region
summarise_reported_rates(case_data, population_data, by = "Zone") %>%
  mutate(share_cases = 100 * cases / sum(cases)) %>%
  arrange(desc(incidence_100k)) %>%
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "Reported incidence and mortality by health region")

summarise_reported_rates(case_data, population_data, by = character(0)) %>%
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "National reported incidence and mortality")
```

## Figure 3: Seasonality patterns

### Evaluate seasonality curves for each province and period
```{r}
season_prov_smooth <- eval_seasonality_curves(
  fit = fit, H = 3, P = 4, S = length(stan_data$region_id),
  entity = "province",
  region_id = stan_data$region_id,
  month_grid = seq(1, 12, length.out = 241)
)

```

### Compute seasonality indices and cluster provinces

```{r}
# K = 3 is justified in section 3.4. With nstart = 25 the partition does not
# depend on the seed; set.seed only makes the k-means starts reproducible.
set.seed(seed)
seasonality_indices <- compute_seasonality_indices(season_prov_smooth)
seasonality_indices <- cluster_seasonality(seasonality_indices, k = 3)
```

### 3.1 Plot seasonality curves by cluster

```{r}
p_seasonality <- plot_seasonality_by_cluster(season_prov_smooth, seasonality_indices) +
  ggtitle("Seasonality pattern characteristics") 

print(p_seasonality)
```

### 3.4 Choice of K and robustness of the seasonal patterns
#### Cluster validity metrics

Elbow (within-cluster sum of squares), average silhouette width,
gap statistic and bootstrap stability (median and 5th percentile adjusted Rand index between the full-data partition and partitions refitted on 200 bootstrap resamples) for K = 1 to 8.

```{r cluster-validity}
#| label: cluster-validity
set.seed(seed)
cluster_metrics <- cluster_validity_metrics(seasonality_indices, k_range = 1:8)

cluster_metrics |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))) |>
  kable(caption = "Cluster validity metrics for k-means on seasonal features")
```

```{r cluster-validity-plot}
#| label: cluster-validity-plot
g_cluster_validity <- plot_cluster_validity(cluster_metrics, k_selected = 3)
print(g_cluster_validity)
```

```{r}
if(export_plot){
png(here("Plots", "FigureSx_cluster_validity.png"), width = 12, height = 4, units = "in", res = 300)
print(g_cluster_validity)
dev.off()
}
```

#### What separates the patterns
```{r cluster-feature-summary}
#| label: cluster-feature-summary
seasonality_indices |>
  group_by(clusters) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    peak_month = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f-%.1f)", median(peak_month), min(peak_month), max(peak_month)),
    amp_ratio = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", median(amp_ratio), min(amp_ratio), max(amp_ratio)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Median (range) of peak month and amplitude ratio by pattern")

set.seed(seed)
cluster_encoding_sensitivity(seasonality_indices, k = 3) |>
  mutate(ari_vs_main = round(ari_vs_main, 3)) |>
  kable(caption = "Agreement (ARI) of K = 3 partitions under alternative feature encodings")
```

#### Posterior uncertainty in pattern membership
```{r cluster-posterior-membership}
#| label: cluster-posterior-membership
draw_membership <- seasonality_draw_membership(fit, seasonality_indices, H = 3, P = 4)

membership_prob <- draw_membership |>
  left_join(seasonality_indices |>
              transmute(region = as.character(region), period = as.character(period), clusters),
            by = c("region", "period")) |>
  group_by(region, period, clusters) |>
  summarise(p_assigned = mean(draw_cluster == clusters), .groups = "drop")

membership_prob |>
  summarise(
    median_p = median(p_assigned),
    share_p_ge_0.5 = mean(p_assigned >= 0.5),
    share_p_ge_0.8 = mean(p_assigned >= 0.8)
  )

membership_prob |>
  group_by(clusters) |>
  summarise(median_p = median(p_assigned), share_p_ge_0.8 = mean(p_assigned >= 0.8))
```

```{r cluster-posterior-stability}
#| label: cluster-posterior-stability

# Provinces that never changed pattern: point estimate vs posterior distribution
n_unchanged_point <- seasonality_indices %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(n_clusters = n_distinct(clusters)) %>%
  filter(n_clusters == 1) %>%
  nrow()

n_unchanged_draws <- draw_membership |>
  group_by(.draw, region) |>
  summarise(unchanged = n_distinct(draw_cluster) == 1, .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(.draw) |>
  summarise(n = sum(unchanged))

tibble(
  estimate = c("Posterior-median curves", "Posterior draws: median",
               "Posterior draws: 2.5%", "Posterior draws: 97.5%"),
  n_unchanged = c(n_unchanged_point, quantile(n_unchanged_draws$n, c(0.5, 0.025, 0.975)))
) |>
  mutate(pct_provinces = round(100 * n_unchanged / stan_data$S, 1)) |>
  kable(caption = "Provinces that kept the same pattern in all four periods")
```

#### Pattern shares and geographic distribution

```{r cluster-period-proportions}
#| label: cluster-period-proportions
seasonality_indices %>%
  group_by(period, clusters) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  mutate(proportion = n / sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(period, clusters)
```

```{r cluster-region-distribution}
#| label: cluster-region-distribution
# Pattern membership in 2019-2024 by geographic region (Fig. 5 map)
area_list <- read_csv(here("Analysis_Data", "area_list.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

seasonality_p4_region <- seasonality_indices %>%
  filter(period == "Period 4") %>%
  mutate(Province = site_levels[as.integer(sub("Province ", "", region))]) %>%
  left_join(area_list, by = "Province")

seasonality_p4_region %>% count(Climate, clusters) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clusters, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  kable(caption = "Provinces per pattern in 2019-2024 by geographic region")

seasonality_p4_region %>% filter(clusters == "Pattern 3") %>% select(Province, Region, Zone)
```

## Source data for figures (S1 Data)

Numerical data underlying Figs 1-5 and the cluster-validity figure, written to
`Source_data/` as CSV files and combined into `Source_data/S1_Data.xlsx` (one
sheet per file plus a README sheet). Figure numbers follow the manuscript.
Posterior summaries are medians or means with 95% credible intervals, matching
the corresponding figure.

```{r source-data-export}
#| label: source-data-export
library(writexl)

source_dir <- here("Source_data")
dir.create(source_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

period_labels <- c("Period 1" = "2003-2007", "Period 2" = "2008-2012",
                   "Period 3" = "2013-2018", "Period 4" = "2019-2024")
health_region <- function(zone) paste0("Health Region ", as.integer(sub("Zone", "", zone)))
foi_to_incidence <- function(foi) (1 - exp(-foi)) * 1e5

source_data <- list(
  # Fig 1: reported surveillance data
  fig1_reported_province_year = case_data %>%
    group_by(province = Area, health_region = health_region(Zone), year) %>%
    summarise(reported_cases = sum(case), reported_deaths = sum(death), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(population_data %>% group_by(province = Province, year) %>%
                summarise(population = sum(Total), .groups = "drop"),
              by = c("province", "year")),
  fig1_reported_rates_province = province_rates %>%
    transmute(province = Area, health_region = health_region(Zone), reported_cases = cases,
              reported_deaths = deaths, person_years,
              incidence_per_100k = incidence_100k, mortality_per_1m = mortality_1m,
              age_standardised_incidence_per_100k = asr_incidence_100k,
              age_standardised_mortality_per_1m = asr_mortality_1m),
  fig1_reported_age_distribution = case_age_data %>%
    group_by(age_group = age_group_new) %>%
    summarise(reported_cases = sum(case), reported_deaths = sum(death), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(percent_cases = 100 * reported_cases / sum(reported_cases),
           percent_deaths = 100 * reported_deaths / sum(reported_deaths)),

  # Fig 2: reporting proportion
  fig2_reporting_proportion = Se_summ %>%
    transmute(health_region = as.character(region), year,
              median = q500, lower_95 = q025, upper_95 = q975),

  # Fig 3: annual force of infection and estimated infection incidence
  fig3_foi_incidence = lambda_data %>%
    transmute(province, health_region = health_region(region), year,
              annual_foi_median = q500, annual_foi_lower_95 = q025, annual_foi_upper_95 = q975,
              incidence_per_100k_median = foi_to_incidence(q500),
              incidence_per_100k_lower_95 = foi_to_incidence(q025),
              incidence_per_100k_upper_95 = foi_to_incidence(q975)),

  # Fig 4: age-specific relative susceptibility and case-fatality
  fig4_relative_susceptibility = rho_summ %>%
    transmute(period = period_labels[period], age_group,
              mean, lower_95 = q025, upper_95 = q975),
  fig4_case_fatality = CFR_summ %>%
    transmute(period = period_labels[period], age_group = as.character(age_group),
              cfr_percent_mean = 100 * mean, cfr_percent_lower_95 = 100 * q025,
              cfr_percent_upper_95 = 100 * q975,
              relative_cfr_mean = mean_rel_CFR, relative_cfr_lower_95 = q025_ref_CFR,
              relative_cfr_upper_95 = q975_rel_CFR),

  # Fig 5: seasonal multipliers and pattern assignment
  fig5_seasonal_multiplier = season_prov_smooth %>%
    transmute(province = site_levels[as.integer(sub("Province ", "", entity))],
              period = period_labels[as.character(period)], month = x,
              median = q500, lower_95 = q025, upper_95 = q975),
  fig5_seasonal_patterns = seasonality_indices %>%
    left_join(membership_prob %>% select(region, period, p_assigned),
              by = c("region", "period")) %>%
    transmute(province = site_levels[as.integer(sub("Province ", "", region))],
              period = period_labels[as.character(period)], pattern = as.character(clusters),
              peak_month, peak_multiplier = peak_mult, amplitude_ratio = amp_ratio,
              posterior_membership_probability = p_assigned),

  # Supplementary figure: choice of K
  figSx_cluster_validity = cluster_metrics
)

readme <- tibble(
  sheet = names(source_data),
  description = c(
    "Reported cases, deaths and population by province and year (Fig 1)",
    "Average annual reported incidence per 100,000 and mortality per 1,000,000 by province, crude and age-standardised (Fig 1A-B)",
    "Reported cases and deaths by age group, 2004-2024 (Fig 1F)",
    "Estimated reporting proportion by health region and year, posterior median and 95% CrI (Fig 2)",
    "Estimated annual force of infection and infection incidence per 100,000 at-risk population by province and year, posterior median and 95% CrI (Fig 3)",
    "Relative susceptibility by period and age group, posterior mean and 95% CrI (Fig 4, left)",
    "Case-fatality rate among reported cases (%) and relative case-fatality rate by period and age group, posterior mean and 95% CrI (Fig 4, right)",
    "Seasonal multiplier by province, period and month, posterior median and 95% CrI (Fig 5)",
    "Seasonal pattern features, assigned pattern and posterior membership probability by province and period (Fig 5)",
    "Cluster validity metrics for K = 1-8 (supplementary figure on the choice of K)"
  )
)

iwalk(source_data, \(d, name) write_csv(d, file.path(source_dir, paste0(name, ".csv"))))
write_csv(readme, file.path(source_dir, "README.csv"))
write_xlsx(c(list(README = readme), source_data), file.path(source_dir, "S1_Data.xlsx"))

readme %>% mutate(rows = map_int(source_data, nrow)) %>% kable()
```

## Posterior predictive checks and additional diagnostics

```{r}
# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
dir_create(here("Plots", "predictive_check", dataset))
S <- stan_data$S
T <- stan_data$T
Y <- stan_data$Y
# Collect plots in a list

plot_list <- vector("list", S)
for (s_idx in seq_len(S)) {
  plot_data <- ppc_cases_by_province(s_idx = s_idx)
  plot_list[[s_idx]] <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = date)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = yrep_q025, ymax = yrep_q975), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.20) +
    geom_line(aes(y = yrep_q500), color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(y = observed_case), color = "black", size = 1.6, alpha = 0.6) +
    labs(
      x = "", y = "Reported cases",
      title = unique(plot_data$province)  # Province name as title
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 18)
}

# Arrange plots in 3x4 grids and export each page as PNG
plots_per_page <- 4
n_pages <- ceiling(S / plots_per_page)
for (i in seq_len(n_pages)) {
  idx_start <- (i - 1) * plots_per_page + 1
  idx_end <- min(i * plots_per_page, S)
  plots_this_page <- plot_list[idx_start:idx_end]
  arranged <- ggarrange(plotlist = plots_this_page, ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
  png(here("Plots", "predictive_check", dataset, sprintf("predictive_check_page%02d.png", i)), width = 16, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
  print(arranged)
  dev.off()
}

```


## Supplementary: Per-province composite figures

```{r supplementary-province-plots}
#| label: supplementary-province-plots

if(export_plot){
  supp_dir <- here("Plots", "Supplementary")
  dir.create(supp_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  source(here("Scripts", "plot_functions.R"))
  
  # Build province summary table (once, used for all provinces)
  prov_summ <- build_province_summary(
    lambda_data, Se_summ, seasonality_indices,
    map_data, calendar, stan_data
  )
  
  # Sort provinces alphabetically for figure numbering
  alpha_order <- order(site_levels)
  
  for (fig_i in seq_along(alpha_order)) {
    s_idx <- alpha_order[fig_i]
    prov_name <- site_levels[s_idx]
    
    tryCatch({
      plot_province_diagnostic(
        s_idx = s_idx,
        province_summary = prov_summ,
        season_curves = season_prov_smooth,
        map_data = map_data,
        config = list(
          use_log = FALSE,
          show_age = TRUE
        ),
        fig_number = fig_i,
        output_dir = supp_dir
      )
      cat(sprintf("  Exported: %s (fig %d, s_idx %d)\n", prov_name, fig_i, s_idx))
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("  FAILED: %s (fig %d) — %s\n", prov_name, fig_i, e$message))
    })
  }
}
```


## 2. Model Diagnostics

### 2.1 Convergence Summary

```{r convergence}
#| label: convergence

# Extract summary statistics
fit_summary <- summary(fit)$summary

# Key parameters to check
key_params <- c("phi_case", "phi_death", "mu_log_lambda_0", 
               "sigma_Se", "sigma_rho", "sigma_CFR", "mu_logit_CFR")

convergence_tbl <- fit_summary[key_params, c("mean", "sd", "2.5%", "97.5%", "n_eff", "Rhat")] |>
 as.data.frame() |>
 rownames_to_column("Parameter") |>
 mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))

kable(convergence_tbl, caption = "Convergence diagnostics for key parameters")
```
